# P0-B: NonNullable and ES5 Awaited

Frozen against TypeScript 5.9.3 before production changes. The two input/reference
pairs retain their original bytes; operator controls are independent observations.

| Files | Forms/profiles | Comparisons | Accepted inventories/files | Consumers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cases.json / reference.json | 91 × four | 364 | 283 / 299 | 566 |
| operator-cases.json / operator-reference.json | eight × four | 32 | 32 / 32 | 64 |
| Complete scope | 99 × four | 396 | 315 / 331 | 630 |

All 331 accepted JavaScript files need selected-edition syntax checks. Twelve
executions belong to the primary matrix. Complete diagnostics include related
information and UTF-16 positions. Keep every accepted declaration byte exact.

The ES5 loose-null profile intentionally combines strict=true with
strictNullChecks=false; Native accepts that configuration. Keep this profile
and explicit-option validation. Ordinary Present/Unwrap aliases prevent utility
spelling from replacing shared intersection, conditional and infer semantics.

boundary-controls.json separately freezes six owner/runtime and nine configured
resource controls. These are excluded from direct Native agreement. Cyclic
Awaited demands require Native TS2589, separately from resource-limit refusals.

The phase plan records all hashes, the unchanged previous compiler's baseline,
implementation obligations and complete acceptance requirements. These fixtures
do not establish that the implementation or P0-B acceptance is complete.

`demand-reference.json` retains six additional TypeScript 5.9.3 observations for
call-result and ordinary-alias cycles, guarded/decreasing recursion and retention
of an independent error. They are separate controls, outside the 396-case direct
matrix. Six additional zero/one-work checks in the Rust test exercise configured
refusal of declared and inferred demands; they are separate from the original
nine resource controls.

The versioned tools are `tools/record_nonnullable_awaited.cjs` (primary matrix and
six demand controls, or `--operators` for the ordinary matrix) and
`tools/verify_nonnullable_awaited.cjs` (all accepted declaration inventories,
isolated consumers, selected-edition syntax and execution). Paths are relative
to `development/browser_core/phase-18-bluets/`. Recorder execution verifies frozen
references and has no overwrite mode.
